overview: A simple single-user todo web app (Node.js + Express + Vue.js + SQLite) that lets users manage tasks with a title, due date, and done/not-done status.
problem_statement: Need a simple, local way to track daily tasks without the complexity of cloud-based todo apps.

goals.item: Add, edit, and delete tasks with title and due date
goals.reason: Core functionality — without CRUD the app has no value

goals.item: Mark tasks as done or not done

goals.reason: Data survives browser refreshes and app restarts

non_goals.reason: Keeps the app simple for v1
Out of scope for initial version

assumptions.assumption: App runs locally on the user's machine
SQLite database file is accessible at all times
No concurrent access from multiple devices

constraints.description: Tech stack: Node.js + Express + SQLite + Vue.js
Single-user only — no multi-tenancy or auth

success_metrics: Data persists across browser refreshes and app restarts
Basic CRUD operations (create, read, update, delete) work without errors
